entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, VeloFit agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to return something. It's a helmet I bought for my son. I just... I feel terrible about it.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with the purchase. To start, could you please provide the order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. We got it a few weeks ago. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I've never returned anything before. I really needed this to be right.

Thank you, I've pulled up your account. I see you're a VIP member with us; we appreciate your loyalty. I see the Pro-Weave helmet, delivered 27 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's just a preference, I guess. It's the color. Online it looked like a bright red, but in person, it's more of a maroon. My son was so disappointed. The box is still unopened, we haven't even touched it. With things being so tight, I really needed that money back if it wasn't perfect.

I completely understand. Getting the color right is important, especially for gear you rely on. And when it comes to a helmet, ensuring your son loves it is key to making sure he wears it for his safety. Let me just check the policy for you.
Oh, I hope it's okay. I know it's been almost a month.

Not a problem at all. I see here that for standard items like this helmet, VeloFit has a 90-day return window. Since you're well within that timeframe and the box is unopened, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
Really? Oh, thank you so much, Sarah! That's such a relief. I was so worried. You've really helped me out.

Of course. And as a thank you for being a VIP member, I'm going to email you a prepaid return shipping label right now, so you won't have to pay to send it back. I've also added a 10% discount to your account for your next purchase, in case you find a different color he likes better.
Wow, that is so kind of you. You've made my day. We'll definitely be looking for another helmet from you guys. Thank you again!
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
